acceptance_criteria: ordinary telemetry excludes raw media, unrestricted transcripts, secrets, biometrics, and restricted facility details
logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and audit correlation are tenant/project safe and low cardinality
SLOs and performance budgets are versioned by endpoint, viewer tier, capture device, processing profile, and execution profile
cost estimates and actuals are attributable by tenant, project, capture, run, stage, model, and immutable price version
quota and budget admission are race-safe, idempotent, auditable, and release reservations after failure
support access is customer approved, exact-scope, time bound, revocable, and cannot expose raw assets by default
support bundles are complete, checksummed, independently verifiable, and fail closed on unsafe or unexpected content
complete clean-source acceptance and independent inner/outer verification return zero findings
dependency_rationale: OPS-002 is the only authorized successor to accepted OPS-001. OPS-003, OPS-004, QA-002, pilots, Progress 09, and production remain outside this milestone.
external_gaps: Compatibility contracts can be tested locally; real CUDA/driver/container combinations require approved GPU hardware.
Isolation contracts can be tested locally; GPU job boundary validation requires executable GPU infrastructure.
Checkpoint/resume reference behavior can be tested locally; actual preemption requires GPU/queue infrastructure.
Synthetic game-day exercises can be automated; staffed operational exercises require external participants.
Requires supported physical iOS devices and declared thermal conditions.
Requires physical-device/network bandwidth and foreground-responsiveness validation.

included_requirements.requirement: Logs shall be structured and include release, service, tenant-safe context, trace, operation, outcome, and stable error code.
Metrics shall identify model/checkpoint and capture profile without leaking personal or facility-identifying values.
Distributed traces shall connect ingest, orchestration, worker, storage, validation, and publication.
Quality dashboards shall show drift, coverage, residuals, confidence distribution, failed regions, and comparison to prior versions.
Audit events shall be append-only and protected from ordinary support modification.
Each component shall declare blast radius, retry safety, recovery point, recovery time, and degraded behavior.
Worker resource exhaustion shall terminate the job without terminating shared control-plane services.
Object-store write success shall be followed by hash verification before database publication.
Index outage shall fall back to bounded metadata navigation rather than returning unauthorized or stale results.
Provider-region failure shall not trigger unapproved cross-region data movement.
Each compute profile shall pin resolution, dtype, backend, model, window policy, memory limit, timeout, output class, and expected quality tier.

included_requirements.external_gap_reason: Compatibility contracts can be tested locally; real CUDA/driver/container combinations require approved GPU hardware.
included_requirements.requirement: The scheduler shall prevent incompatible CUDA/driver/container combinations.

included_requirements.external_gap_reason: Isolation contracts can be tested locally; GPU job boundary validation requires executable GPU infrastructure.
included_requirements.requirement: GPU workers shall run one tenant security context per isolated job or approved batch boundary.
OOM fallback shall be explicit and recorded; silent parameter reduction is prohibited.
Cost estimation shall include decode, inference, optimization, fusion, splat, semantic processing, storage, and egress.

included_requirements.external_gap_reason: Checkpoint/resume reference behavior can be tested locally; actual preemption requires GPU/queue infrastructure.
included_requirements.requirement: Preempted jobs shall resume from verified checkpoints when supported.

Runbooks shall cover database outage, object corruption, queue backlog, GPU failure, model regression, cross-tenant suspicion, leaked share link, consent failure, bad redaction, deletion error, and backup restore.
Each runbook shall include trigger, severity, roles, commands/controls, decision points, evidence, validation, rollback, and communications.
Incident actions shall be audited and preserve forensic evidence without copying sensitive data unnecessarily.
After-action reviews shall create tracked corrective requirements and tests.

included_requirements.external_gap_reason: Synthetic game-day exercises can be automated; staffed operational exercises require external participants.
included_requirements.requirement: Runbooks shall be exercised through game days.
On-call access shall use just-in-time privileges and recorded sessions where appropriate.

The model shall attribute CPU seconds, GPU seconds by profile, memory, object bytes by tier, database/storage growth, requests, search/vector usage, CDN/egress, transcription/OCR/model API use, and support overhead.
Costs shall roll up by tenant, project, capture, run, stage, model, and calendar period.
Admission control shall enforce project budgets, tenant quotas, concurrency, and anomaly detection.
The UI shall show estimated cost/processing tier before optional expensive final reconstruction.
Capacity plans shall use measured scene minutes/frames/area and peak concurrency with headroom.
A price-source update shall be versioned and not change historical actual-cost records.

included_requirements.external_gap_reason: Reference contracts and deterministic fixtures are implemented; supported physical-device thermal/network foreground validation remains external.
included_requirements.requirement: The iOS app shall maintain capture responsiveness and bounded frame-drop behavior on supported devices under declared thermal conditions.

included_requirements.external_gap_reason: Reference contracts and deterministic fixtures are implemented; supported physical-device thermal/network foreground validation remains external.
included_requirements.requirement: Upload shall saturate available policy-permitted bandwidth while preserving foreground responsiveness and resumability.
API and search SLOs shall be defined by endpoint class and result size.
The viewer shall define frame-time, first-meaningful-scene, memory, and network budgets by device tier and scene size.
Pipeline profiles shall define expected runtime and peak VRAM/RAM per input class.
Load tests shall include noisy-neighbor and tenant-quota behavior.
Support bundles shall contain versions, manifests, metrics, stable errors, hardware/profile, and selected redacted logs without raw media by default.
Customer-approved scene access shall state scope, purpose, personnel, duration, and revocation.
Support engineers shall not copy raw assets to unmanaged systems.
High-risk LiveForever or security-system issues shall route to specially authorized personnel.
Resolved tickets shall link remediation and affected release without retaining unnecessary customer data.
Support tooling shall enforce tenant isolation and cannot generate unrestricted signed URLs.
